faq: Do I need to buy a theme?
Not necessarily. Many good Drupal themes are free and maintained by the community. If you prefer a paid one, you buy the license and we customize it for you.
What is a child theme and do I need one?
A child theme holds your changes separately, so updating the base theme does not erase your work. We recommend it, and include it in the Premium package.
How is this different from theme edits?
This is for sites that want a styled, ready theme from a stock starting point. Theme edits are for fixing or extending a theme you already use.
Can you match a design I already have?
We can get close to a design with a good base theme. For pixel exact custom designs, our redesign or site build services fit better.

Drupal theme customization to match your brand starts from a proven, well maintained theme and tailors it to you. Ecom Swift LLC selects a suitable theme, applies your logo, colors and fonts, and arranges regions, blocks and layouts.

## What is Drupal theme customization?

Drupal theme customization means taking an existing, maintained theme and adapting it to your brand instead of designing every pixel from nothing. The base theme supplies a tested structure: regions, menus, responsive behavior and styling for common elements. Customization adds your identity on top: logo, colors, fonts, spacing, header and footer and the layout of important pages.

This is a faster and more economical route than a fully custom design, and it keeps you on a foundation that other developers recognize.

## Why start from a proven theme

A theme is more than appearance. It decides how the site behaves on small screens, how well it works with a keyboard or a screen reader and how easily it updates when Drupal changes. Building these basics yourself is slow and easy to get wrong.

A maintained theme has already solved many of those problems. When we tailor it with care, you keep that foundation and gain a look that is clearly yours. When we use a child theme, your changes stay separate, so the base theme can be updated without erasing your work.

## How a tailored theme affects results

A consistent, branded look tells visitors they are in the right place and that a real organization stands behind the site. Clear typography and spacing make long pages easier to read. Well arranged regions and blocks put your main message and your call to action where visitors look first.

A good mobile layout keeps phone visitors on the page rather than pinching and zooming. A tidy, light theme also loads faster than a heavy one packed with unused features. We cannot promise a particular lift in enquiries, but a clear and consistent design removes avoidable reasons for visitors to leave.

## What good theme customization includes

- A short list of suitable themes with the strengths of each explained plainly.
- Your logo, favicon and brand colors applied across the site.
- Fonts chosen for readability and loaded efficiently.
- Header and footer arranged to suit your navigation and contact details.
- Regions and blocks placed deliberately: sidebars, banners and calls to action.
- Menu and sidebar styling that matches the rest of the design.
- Layouts tuned for the pages that matter most.
- A mobile pass on every tuned layout.
- A child theme, so future updates to the base theme do not overwrite your changes.
- Custom banner and card blocks plus a short guide for editors in larger packages.

## What we do

We begin by learning about your content and brand, then present a few theme options with reasons. Once you choose, we install the theme on a staging site, apply your identity and build the header, footer and menus. We then arrange regions and blocks and tune the layouts you have named.

The Basic package installs and brands the chosen theme. Standard adds regions, blocks, styled menus and several tuned page layouts. Premium adds a child theme, more layouts, custom blocks and a video guide for editors. You review a private preview, request changes and approve before launch.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Send your logo files, colors and any brand guide.
- Choose fonts that are readable on a phone.
- Decide which pages need their own layout.
- Keep customizations in a child theme.
- Ask editors what they find hard to change today.

**Avoid:**
- Buying a theme because of its demo, before checking it suits your content.
- Editing the base theme files directly.
- Using too many fonts and colors.
- Choosing a theme that has not been updated for a long time.
- Expecting a heavy custom look from a quick theme tailoring job.

## Who this is for

This suits a new Drupal site that needs a professional look at a sensible cost. It suits an organization with a brand guide that wants it applied properly, and a team that has a working site with an unstyled default theme.

## What we need from you

Send your logo, colors, fonts if you have them, and examples of sites you like. Tell us what content your pages show. We work as a developer user in your account and we never ask for passwords. We will confirm theme choice with you before installation, and we explain what is different from theme edits if you are unsure which service you need.
